learning points"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"Dec 7 2023\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOSCE questions\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1. What are bronchial breathsounds how to differentiate it from vesicular breath sounds\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have learnt how to identify bronchial breath sounds clinically\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBrochial breath sounds\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt is loud, hollow, and high pitch\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EExpiratory phase is longer than inspiratory phase\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is distinct pause between inspiration and expiration due to absent alveolar phase\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVesicular breathsounds\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESoft, low pitched, and rustling in quality\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; a) Inspiratory phase remains\u0026nbsp; longer than the\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; expiratory phase\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; b)\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Inspiration is higher pitch than expiration\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;c) No pause between inspiration and expiration\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhat are crepitations? How they occur ?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECrepitations are adventitious breath sounds.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECrepitations are made either by air passages and alveoli (air sacs) opening up during inspiration or by air bubbling through fluid. They are not normally heard in healthy lungs.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDuring expiration alveoli stick together while during inspiration the alveolar walls are seperated with difficulty and only at the end of inspiration\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECrepitations is silight crackling sound that can be\u0026nbsp; imitated by\u0026nbsp; rubbing a strand of hair.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Ventilator weaning criteria\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESubjective assesment\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAdequate cough\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo neuromuscular blocking agents\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAbsence of extra tracheobronchial secretions\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EReversal of underlying cause for respiratory failure\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo continous sedative infusion\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EObjective measurments\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EStable cardiovascular status\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHeart rate \u0026lt;140 beat\/min\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo active myocardial ischemia\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAdequate hemoglobin level \u0026gt;8g\/dl\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESystolic blood pressure 90-160mmHg\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfebrile\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EAdequate effort\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERespiratory rate \u0026lt;35\/min.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPao2 \u0026gt;60 and paCo2\u0026lt;60mmHg\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo significant respiratory acidosis Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient\/ attender was informed the purpose of the information being acquired. An informed consent was taken from patient\/ attender and there is omission of information that was requested to be omitted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 83yr old male came with complaints of\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ecough since 20 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFever since 19 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShortness of breath 17 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of Presenting illness:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was admitted to ICU on 20\/11\/23 in the morning at 10 am with\u0026nbsp; breathlessness. It was insidious in onset and gradually progressive, continuous and present during rest ( patient\u0026nbsp; was feeling breathless even upon walking to washroom) with no associated relieving factors. Patient's attender also complained of awakening during night due to breathlessness. No h\/o palpitations, stridor, or hoarseness of voice\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatients attender also told abt\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;cough which was insidious in onset, gradually progressive associated with sputum which was white in colour ,scanty\u0026nbsp; amount, mucoid in consistency and non foul smelling\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Patient also complained of intermittent spikes of fever\u0026nbsp; since 19 days( 4 times a day ), associated with chills and rigors, not relieved on taking medication and not associated with headache, vomiting\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;No h\/o chest pain, orthopnea\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o recurrent sore throat or cold\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o loss of consciousness,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo history of similar complaints in the past\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is N\/K\/C\/O of Hypertension, Diabetes mellitus, TB, Epilepsy, Bronchial asthma, Thyroid disorders\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o blood transfusions and surgeries\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EFAMILY HISTORY\u003C\/b\u003E: Insignificant\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eas mentioned by the attender\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet - Mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite - decreased\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep- Adequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and Bladder movements- Regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddiction - consumption of alcohol occasionally,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eh\/o smoking since 30 yrs (3 packs per day) reduced to 1 pack per day since 2 yrs\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION :\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is conscious, coherent and cooperative.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is moderately built\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is presence of pallor ,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Epedal edema up to the knee\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
